Khuddakanikāya
or Khuddaka Gantha. fifth division of Sutta Piṭaka; according to one [Page185-b] view Khuddakaº includes Vinaya an. Abhidhamma with 15 books, beg. with Khuddakapāṭha; acc. to Dīghabhāṇaka school, it contains 12 books, an. acc. to Majjhimabhāṇaka, 15 books.
See

, p. 27.
For a study of the original form of Pāli Khuddaka Nikāya an. its development an. chronology of individual sections, see E. Mayeda, J. of Ind. an. Bud. Studies, Tokyo, 498-504 (from rear).

Khuddasikkhā
Bud. Pāli. a compendium of Vinaya, mostly in verses, according to [Page186-b] its last stanzas composed by Dhammasiri of Ceylon; according to some Burmese histories, by a. associate of Dharmasiri, viz. Mahāsāmi of Ceylon; dated variously in 440 A. D., 6th or 7th Cent. (Mu7ller),
, p.. 86-87; Wint. HIL. II. p. 221 an. Geiger, Pāli Lit. an. Lang. (Eng. transl., Cal.

), p.. 35, 39.
